text: Hm? Report to the Warden first, tall one. Rings are not handed out to strangers.
Hah. Another tall one with an empty ring. I'm Oddrin, ring-sage of this outpost.
A ring is a promise. You bind a creature, you protect it - and it fights beside you.
I keep three young creatures for new wardens. Choose one. Choose well.
Good. Wild creatures hide in tall grass. When one jumps out, you fight it together - creature and warrior.
Weaken it, then throw a Binding Ring. Here, take five. Then find Scout Vel on the Hollow Road.
Oh-ho! Look at that. Bound and not even bitten. Here, a few rings more - and these tonics.
Tired? The Ring Stone outside restores you all. Or I can see to your creatures now.
There. Spirits restored, scratches gone. Off you go.
